title: Employ staff under the General Retail Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the General Retail Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: General Retail Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: (a) employers in the general retail industry throughout Australia;

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: General Retail Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 general retail industry means the retail sale or hire of goods or services for personal, household or business consumption including: (a) clothing; and (b) food; and (c) furniture and household goods; and (d) personal and recreational goods; and (e) bakery shops at which the predominant activity is baking products for sale on the premises

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: 1174 (bakeries that bake for sale on the premises) is named in cl 4.2(e) although the ABS puts it in Manufacturing; 4310 (non-store retailing) is inferred from the general definition.
